profile.name: computer-vision-generative-models
profile.description: Research profile for computer vision with an emphasis on generative modeling.

research.summary: The user is interested in computer vision research, especially generative models for images and videos.
interests: visual representation learning useful for generation
negative_topics: pure natural language processing with no visual component
classical optimization unrelated to machine learning or vision
recommendation systems with no visual component
evaluation_guidance: Judge methodological relevance, not only keyword overlap.
A paper can be relevant even if it does not explicitly use the phrase generative model.
Methods that could substantially improve visual generation should be considered relevant.
General computer vision papers should receive a high score only if the method is plausibly useful for generative visual modeling.
Papers that are only superficially related should receive a low score.

questions.generation: Is this paper relevant to visual generative modeling?
questions.image_generation: Is this paper relevant to image generation?
questions.video_generation: Is this paper relevant to video generation?
questions.diffusion_or_flow: Is this paper relevant to diffusion, flow matching, rectified flow, consistency models, or closely related generative methods?
questions.multimodal: Is this paper relevant to multimodal generative models involving visual information?
questions.three_d: Is this paper relevant to 3D generative modeling, neural rendering, or generative 3D vision?
